name: Business trip plan
summary: The assistant hands the traveller one plan for one business trip: dates and nights fixed from the brief, travel and hotel options with prices and the day each was checked, a day-by-day timetable around the meetings, the cost against travel policy and the bookings still to make. Nothing is booked or paid.

sources.title: The business-trip form of the work: the timing check against fixed meetings with set margins, the check against a pasted travel policy and its approver, the price age that triggers a recheck, the list of bookings still to make with their deadlines, the default option headers with a stop on any mismatch, and the acceptance tests.

sources.contribution: Settling dates and nights before any price and redoing the figures when they move; checking the starting airport and each place's town first; setting aside options that break the traveller's needs before comparing the rest; showing where each price was found; recording why a dearer choice was needed when policy is in question.
Pricing the exact route and dates rather than a headline fare, giving the cheapest choice that works and a second one, and marking an extra charge as not priced instead of guessing it.
